steps.prompt: Our LD passes up the far wall. Their LW stays close to you. What are they waiting for?

options.text: For me to leave my wall for the middle
options.fb: Right. Their LW stays close so they can follow you. Leave now and you pull them into the middle lane, and it is covered before the puck gets there.

options.text: For a pass back across to my wall
options.fb: Possible, and you are the outlet if it comes back. But their LW is mostly watching you. Leave early and they come with you, and the middle is covered.

options.text: For a chance to chase our LD behind the net
options.fb: Their LW is not chasing our LD. They stay close to you, ready to follow you into the middle the moment you leave your wall.

steps.prompt: The puck is moving up the far wall to our LW. Where are you?

options.text: Leaving my hash marks for the middle lane
options.fb: Right. You leave as the pass goes, and now their LW is too late to follow. You reach the middle lane with speed just as our LW needs you.

options.text: Still at my hash marks, waiting for control
options.fb: Half a second late. The pressure reaches our LW while you are still on your wall. They have nobody in the middle, so they get hit or pass without looking.

options.text: Already in the middle, since the start
options.fb: Their LW followed you. The middle lane is covered, our LW has nobody to pass to, and the pass they force is taken in front of you.

options.text: Staying on my wall, ready for a pass
options.fb: Then nobody is in the middle. Our LW is alone against the pressure, and the breakout ends on the far wall.

steps.prompt: The puck is moving up the far wall. Tap where you should be.

fb.right: Just off your hash marks, leaving now for the middle lane. Their LW is still on the wall.
fb.close: On the right path, but a stride early or late. Early, their LW comes with you. Late, our LW waits for you.
fb.wrong: Still standing on your wall, or already in the middle. One leaves our LW alone. The other brings their LW into the lane with you.
